dedupe_keys.name: the offshore oil and gas platforms oogps dataset based on satellite data spanning 2017 to 2023

description: Universitat Politècnica de València publishes a satellite-derived inventory of offshore oil and gas platforms for six major basins. The dataset covers the Gulf of Mexico, Persian Gulf, North Sea, Caspian Sea, Gulf of Guinea and Gulf of Thailand during 2017–2023. Vector features include platform location, country, exclusive economic zone, flaring status and installation or removal dates. Zenodo supplies a version 1.0.0 ZIP archive under CC-BY-4.0, with open and free access. The exact vector encoding was not established from the landing metadata. Six large basins do not constitute complete worldwide coverage, and satellite-inferred dates or flaring flags should not be treated as certified operating histories. These features could support offshore asset exposure, infrastructure-retirement scenarios or environmental comparisons when joined to storm, spill or engineering data. The inventory complements onshore energy-asset registers with offshore locations and temporal attributes. It does not supply pipeline connectivity, production rates or platform-specific structural fragility.
